name: Orion's Belt
description: The three mighty stars of Orion's Belt, guiding wanderers through the winter nights.

name: Andromeda Galaxy
description: A swirling cosmic island, a beacon of distant futures and ancient pasts.

name: Southern Cross
description: A celestial jewel, a compass for those navigating the southern skies.

name: Carina Nebula
description: A vast stellar nursery, where new worlds are born amidst cosmic dust and light.

name: Lyra Constellation
description: Home to Vega, a bright star singing ancient melodies across the void.

name: The Pleiades (Seven Sisters)
description: A sparkling cluster of young stars, often seen as a tiny dipper, inspiring awe and wonder.

name: Milky Way Galactic Core
description: The luminous heart of our own galaxy, a dense region of stars and cosmic dust, best viewed from dark skies.
